paper_metadata.title: The influence of thermomechanical processing on the structure and mechanical properties of rods made of high-strength titanium alloys of different classes

evidence.quote: The paper investigated the influence of the parameters of thermomechanical processing on the structure formation in rods of 16 mm in diameter from (a + b) and near- b-titanium alloys.
